headword: {集合住宅|しゅうごうじゅうたく}
reading: しゅうごうじゅうたく

definitions.gloss: apartment building; multi-unit housing; collective housing
definitions.explanation: A building containing multiple dwelling units, such as apartments, condominiums, or public housing.
